_comment: Optional. If you have had a consumer genomics report and want its actionable takeaways surfaced next to your training data, transcribe them here yourself. This ships EMPTY on purpose: genetic results are the most identifying health data there is, and no example set belongs in a public repository. With an empty list the dashboard renders an empty state and nothing else changes.

_shape.title: Short label for the finding
_shape.action: What you actually do differently because of it

_caution: Consumer genomics reports are probabilistic and often overstated. Treat anything here as a prompt to ask a clinician a better question, never as a diagnosis or a reason to change medication.
